result:
Round 138 (V-0.4a, the clip gesture texts in English) **passes**. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true, and there are no Critical, High or Medium findings. I did not change any app source: the store tree still holds exactly A's 24 granted files, and the protected files are unchanged against `7e6202b`.

**Offline checks**
- **A's tests:** I re-ran A's 25-file vitest list and got 527/527, the same as A.
- **File scope:** the frozen list and A's end hashes match at the start and at the end of my phase.
- **Code review of the change:** only the listed text lines and imports changed, and no handler, condition or class. The test changes swap Georgian for hand-written English literals with the same matchers and selectors. No `it` was added or removed, and no test imports the strings module. The new `clip-strings-ui` tests match the spec.

**Browser checks** (Playwright, fresh context each session, 1440×900 and 1280×720, Snap off at every start). The final runs passed 73/73 checks at each viewport:
- **Move, blocked move, trim, move to another track, group move, no-change:** every status line and Undo title is exactly the specified English. Each one agrees with the clip positions I measured: the blocked move stopped at 3.875 s with no overlap, and a group drag moved both clips by the same amount.
- **Fades:** the texts are exact for audio and video. On real audio output, the first 200 ms of the clip measured about −22 dBFS without the fade and −47 dBFS with a 1 s fade-in, about 25 dB lower (the task asked for at least 6 dB). It was silent before the clip, so the comparison is against a real signal level.
- **Folded title, range badge, round-137 range line:** all exact.
- **Georgian count:** 0 after the allowed exceptions. The only Georgian left on the clip surface is data: track names, clip titles, and the default group name `ჯგუფი 1`, which belongs to the later V-0.4d stage.
- **Layout:** 0 changes over 1 px compared with round 137.
- **Auth and network:** a fresh context with no credentials opens the demo page. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. There were no forbidden requests, Authorization headers, hydration errors or page errors.
- **Not tested:** the fake-Bearer 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

**Two Low findings** (go to `deferred_low_polish`):
- **C-R138-01:** doc 113 now says "selector" twice in two places ("track-header selector (l.331)-ის selector"). It comes from the replacement text the task prescribed.
- **C-R138-02** (existed before this round, not a regression): after a trim or move that gets blocked, the "Trim stopped" / "Move blocked" text stays after release, even though the last valid length or position was saved and Undo shows it. A user is told the trim stopped although an edit was made.

**Notes for B**
- **Folded-title row:** the row says to fold a group, but a folded group hides its clips entirely, so the title can't appear. The title shows when you fold the **track** with its fold button, and I verified it there. I did not check the `U` key.
- **Mutations:** I did not re-run them. A reported that one of them (m60) leaves the `gesture-reentry` test green, as A's own Low; the other two tests named for it still fail as expected.

Three failures in my first run were mistakes in my test script, not app bugs; I've listed them in the report. The full test suite, typecheck, build, verify and e2e are left to the root gate.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:

- c-round-138.json
- c-round-138/
